name: Cleaving Strike
description: A heavy weapon strike from an elite/boss Skeleton Guard — replaces the basic attack, noticeably higher damage.

name: Sweeping Cleave
description: Swings its weapon across the whole party, wide-area damage but lighter per target than Cleaving Strike.

name: Finishing Blow
description: Charges for 1 turn (telegraphing the target) then delivers a devastating strike — roughly 60% of the Vanguard's maxHp, enough to fell squishier classes. Not based on the target's current HP %.

name: Crush
description: Moderate damage, also weakens the target's defense for a few turns.

name: Guard Stance
